description: This file defines template classes for managing Web transfer operations, including client and server transfer types, with support for file handling, hashing, and request/response processing within a Web namespace.

classes.name: SingleElementFactoryType
classes.description: Template class for creating a singleton element factory with reference counting.

classes.name: ClientTransferType
classes.description: Template class managing client-side web transfer operations including upload, download, and info collection.

classes.name: ServerTransferType
classes.description: Template class managing server-side web transfer operations including request handling and file storage.

methods.name: StartTransfer
methods.description: Initiates a web transfer with a given request.

methods.name: CollectInfo
methods.description: Collects information about a source URL.

methods.name: Upload
methods.description: Uploads a file to a destination URL.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Downloads a file from a source URL to a destination file.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Virtual method to setup connection parameters.

methods.name: InfoCollected
methods.description: Virtual callback when info is collected.

methods.name: Transferred
methods.description: Virtual callback when transfer is complete.
